title: Lie Detector (Determined That Was a Lie)
blurb: The pause before the verdict is the entire performance. Daytime talk shows built a whole format on this structure — hope builds during the silence, the audience leans forward, and then the ruling lands with no room for appeal — and the internet lifted it wholesale as its favourite way to expose somebody. Play it after excuses, after alibis, and after the message that says 'I'm five minutes away' from somebody who has not yet left the house. Court is permanently in session, and the polygraph has never once been wrong.
origin: The lie-detector verdict format from daytime talk shows (Maury), meme-ified.
